article_blocks.text: Strain Type: Sativa-Dominant Hybrid
Genetics: Mint Jelly Auto × Sensi Amnesia XXL
Breeder: Humboldt Seed Company × Sensi Seeds
THC Content: 25%
CBD Content: N/A
Terpene Profile: limonene , terpinolene, pinene
Primary Flavors: Mandarin Orange, Sweet Citrus
Flowering Time (Indoor): 85–95 days from seed to harvest
Outdoor Harvest Time: 85–95 days after germination
Indoor Yield: 250–300 g/m²
Outdoor Yield: 160–200 g per Plant
Grow Difficulty: Easy

Few autoflowering cannabis varieties manage to capture the energetic personality of traditional Haze genetics while maintaining the compact structure that makes automatic plants so practical. Amnesia Jelly accomplishes this through a collaboration between Humboldt Seed Company and Sensi Seeds, combining two distinctive breeding lines into a sativa-dominant hybrid with a pronounced citrus character. Its fragrance brings together freshly peeled mandarins, sweet tropical fruit, delicate floral notes, and the sharp zest associated with classic Amnesia varieties.

The flowers themselves develop into dense, light-green clusters covered in crystalline trichomes, contrasting with the relatively open structure of the plant. Rather than emphasizing heavy physical sedation, this marijuana cultivar offers an uplifting experience centered on mental stimulation, creativity , and sustained euphoria. Its manageable dimensions, reliable flowering characteristics, and resistance to certain environmental pressures further distinguish it within the expanding world of contemporary autoflowering weed.
Genetics and Lineage

Amnesia Jelly originates from a direct cross between Mint Jelly Automatic and Sensi Amnesia XXL Automatic, developed through the Breeding Grounds collaboration between Humboldt Seed Company and Sensi Seeds. The finished hybrid contains approximately 80% sativa genetics, with autoflowering ancestry contributing to its compact growth and independent flowering cycle. Its genetic composition connects the cerebral character of traditional Amnesia with the dense, resin-rich flowers and confectionery aromas associated with modern Humboldt breeding. This combination produces a cultivar that retains recognizable Haze characteristics without requiring the considerable height or extended maturation period associated with some older sativa varieties.

Sensi Amnesia XXL Automatic provides much of the cerebral foundation. Developed by crossing Original Amnesia with itself and subsequently introducing ruderalis genetics, this parent preserves the energetic effects and citrus-forward fragrance associated with the Amnesia family. Its ancestry belongs to the broader Haze-influenced European cannabis tradition, where vigorous sativa growth and complex lemon aromas became particularly influential. Mint Jelly Automatic contributes a contrasting genetic background developed by Humboldt Seed Company, with Sour Apple Auto and Hella Jelly associated with its parentage. Mint Jelly was selected for compact growth, substantial resin coverage, and a distinctive combination of sweet mint, creamy cake, and candy-like aromas. Bringing these lines together creates an unusually interesting balance between old-school cerebral cannabis and contemporary dessert-oriented genetics.
Effects and Experience

The psychoactive character of Amnesia Jelly begins with a noticeable sensation of mental brightness. A gentle warmth may develop around the head before expanding into a more pronounced feeling of euphoria and heightened engagement. Thoughts can become more animated, while familiar activities may seem unusually interesting or entertaining. Conversation, music, and creative projects often complement this stimulating character. Unlike some heavy indica-dominant hybrids, the experience generally favors alertness and psychological energy over immediate bodily relaxation. Its Haze-influenced ancestry is particularly apparent in the cerebral quality of the initial effects, which may encourage imaginative thinking and sociability.

As the experience continues, a subtle physical component can emerge without overwhelming the mental stimulation. The body may feel lighter and more comfortable, allowing the uplifting sensation to develop into sustained, pleasant intoxication. This progression makes the cultivar more closely associated with daytime or early-evening recreation than immediate sedation. Nevertheless, its reputation for productivity should not be confused with unimpaired cognitive performance. Higher THC exposure may produce racing thoughts, anxiety, dizziness, dry mouth, or difficulty concentrating, especially among inexperienced consumers. No standardized laboratory-confirmed THC percentage has been established for this specific hybrid, making individual product testing important when evaluating potency. Dosage, tolerance, and method of consumption remain significant influences on the overall experience.
Medical Benefits

The stimulating characteristics of Amnesia Jelly may interest medical marijuana patients seeking temporary symptom relief without pronounced physical heaviness. Some individuals find that THC-containing cannabis makes certain forms of persistent discomfort feel less intrusive, particularly when psychological engagement helps redirect attention away from unpleasant sensations. Clinical research has identified modest benefits from some cannabinoid products for certain chronic pain conditions, including neuropathic pain, but these findings cannot be applied automatically to individual cultivars. The uplifting character of this hybrid may appeal to patients who prefer remaining socially engaged or mentally active, although controlled clinical studies evaluating Amnesia Jelly specifically have not been published.

Mood-related symptoms and fatigue represent additional areas of potential interest. The cerebral euphoria may temporarily improve subjective mood, while the energetic character could make leisure activities feel more approachable. However, high-THC cannabis is not an established treatment for depression, chronic fatigue, or generalized anxiety disorders. Some patients experience increased nervousness or panic after consuming stimulating marijuana varieties, particularly at higher doses. THC may also impair judgment, affect cardiovascular responses, and interact with certain prescription medications. Medical suitability depends on cannabinoid composition, individual health history, and professional guidance rather than a strain’s recreational reputation. Patients should consult a qualified healthcare professional before using cannabis to manage persistent symptoms.
Flavor Profile and Aroma

The fragrance of Amnesia Jelly is built around an unusually bright combination of citrus sweetness and floral Haze character. During early development, the plant produces relatively restrained herbal and floral aromas. These become more noticeable as flowering progresses, eventually developing into an assertive mixture of sweet citrus, mandarin peel, and subtle tropical fruit. Unlike the sharp diesel pungency associated with some contemporary hybrids, its aromatic personality emphasizes freshness and sweetness. The Amnesia ancestry contributes a recognizable zesty quality, while Mint Jelly softens the fragrance with sweeter confectionery impressions. The resulting aroma resembles citrus candy with a delicate floral background rather than a conventional lemon-dominant Haze.

Properly cured flowers reveal additional complexity. Breaking apart the dense buds releases concentrated citrus oils, sugary fruit, and a faintly herbal fragrance. During consumption, freshly peeled mandarins form the most recognizable flavor, accompanied by softer tropical notes that reduce the sharper acidity of the citrus. A gentle floral impression develops toward the finish, leaving a lingering combination of sweetness and refreshing zest. Although limonene, terpinolene, and pinene are plausible contributors to these aromatic characteristics, a comprehensive laboratory-confirmed terpene profile has not been published. Other volatile compounds may contribute substantially to the recognizable mandarin fragrance. Careful drying and airtight storage help preserve the delicate citrus elements, which can diminish through excessive heat, oxidation, or prolonged exposure to unsuitable conditions.
Growing Information

Amnesia Jelly develops into a relatively compact cannabis plant with structural characteristics inherited from both parents. Indoor specimens generally reach 70–110 centimeters, while outdoor plants commonly grow approximately 80–120 centimeters under favorable conditions. The ruderalis influence helps maintain manageable dimensions, but the sativa ancestry remains visible through somewhat extended internodal spacing and an open arrangement of branches. Foliage is comparatively sparse, allowing light and air to reach developing flowers without extensive pruning. Mature buds form dense, chunky clusters near branch tips, displaying light-green coloration and substantial crystalline resin coverage. This combination of open architecture and compact flowers creates an attractive contrast between the plant’s overall structure and its mature flowering sites.

The breeder estimates approximately 85–95 days from germination to harvest, a timeline that includes both vegetative development and flowering . Unlike photoperiod marijuana, this feminized autoflower begins flowering according to its developmental age rather than requiring a change in daylight exposure. Indoor yields can reach approximately 250–300 grams per square meter, while outdoor plants may produce 160–200 grams each under favorable conditions. The cultivar performs in temperate and continental climates with sufficiently warm growing seasons. Its relatively compact size also makes it appropriate for limited indoor spaces, including environments where taller Haze-influenced varieties would be difficult to accommodate.

Cultivation difficulty is generally low because the plant requires little structural intervention. Extensive Screen of Green arrangements, mainlining, and aggressive pruning are unnecessary for achieving productive flowering. Minimal foliage also reduces trimming demands during harvest. The breeder identifies useful resistance to certain diseases and mold, although this does not eliminate the need for adequate ventilation and environmental control. Dense flowers can retain moisture under humid conditions, particularly near maturity. Because autoflowering plants have a limited vegetative period, avoiding unnecessary stress is important for maintaining healthy development. With appropriate growing conditions, the cultivar offers a practical combination of relatively straightforward cultivation, manageable dimensions, and substantial resin production.
FAQ
Is Amnesia Jelly an indica or sativa strain?

Amnesia Jelly is a sativa-dominant hybrid containing approximately 80% sativa genetics. Its ancestry combines Mint Jelly Automatic with Sensi Amnesia XXL Automatic, creating a cultivar associated with uplifting cerebral effects and relatively limited physical sedation. Despite its sativa dominance, autoflowering genetics keep the plant considerably more compact than many traditional Haze varieties.
What is the THC percentage of Amnesia Jelly?

An official, consistently documented THC percentage has not been established for the Humboldt Seed Company and Sensi Seeds release. Both parental lines have substantial potency potential, but this does not guarantee a particular cannabinoid concentration in their offspring. Laboratory testing of the specific cannabis product provides the most reliable information about THC strength.
What does Amnesia Jelly taste like?

The flavor combines freshly peeled mandarin oranges, sweet citrus candy, tropical fruit, and delicate floral Haze notes. A subtle herbal quality becomes noticeable toward the finish, creating a refreshing contrast with the dominant sweetness. The Amnesia ancestry contributes the recognizable citrus character, while Mint Jelly introduces additional confectionery complexity.
Does Amnesia Jelly make you sleepy?

Pronounced sleepiness is not generally the defining characteristic of this cultivar. Its effects favor cerebral stimulation, euphoria, and mental engagement, making it more commonly associated with daytime or early-evening recreation. Larger doses can produce fatigue or stronger physical relaxation, although individual responses depend on THC concentration and tolerance.
How long does Amnesia Jelly take from seed to harvest?

The breeder estimates approximately 85–95 days from germination to harvest. Indoor plants typically reach 70–110 centimeters and may produce 250–300 grams per square meter under favorable conditions. Outdoor specimens commonly grow 80–120 centimeters, with potential yields of 160–200 grams per plant. Because it is an autoflowering variety, flowering begins independently of seasonal daylight changes.
Final Thoughts on Amnesia Jelly

Amnesia Jelly represents a thoughtful combination of traditional European Haze breeding and contemporary American autoflowering genetics. Its Sensi Amnesia XXL ancestry supplies the cerebral energy and pronounced citrus character associated with classic Amnesia varieties, while Mint Jelly introduces compact growth, substantial resin production, and additional sweetness. The finished cultivar offers dense, trichome-rich flowers with a refreshing fragrance dominated by mandarins, tropical fruit, and delicate floral notes.

For consumers, the principal attraction lies in its uplifting mental character and relatively energetic experience. Growers benefit from manageable plant dimensions, limited pruning requirements, useful disease resistance, and a predictable seed-to-harvest schedule. The combination of straightforward cultivation and expressive sativa characteristics gives this hybrid a distinctive position among modern automatic marijuana varieties .
